subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR wait for redacted live Telegram/gateway proof after the classifier fix, or may maintainers accept source/test evidence for owner-session delivery?
rationale: The changed behavior is user-visible Telegram completion delivery and this read-only review cannot prove the contributor's live setup or transport routing.

options.title: Require Classifier Fix And Live Proof
options.body: Fix the empty-output classifier path and require redacted Telegram Desktop, gateway-log, terminal/live-output, or linked-artifact proof before merge.

options.title: Accept Source-Only Delivery Risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge with source and regression-test evidence only, while owning the risk that real transport/session delivery still misroutes or drops completions.

options.title: Pause For Broader Delivery Contract
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want one canonical task-completion wake contract across background-task, ACP, exec, and subagent paths first.

recommendation.title: Require Classifier Fix And Live Proof
recommendation.body: Fix the empty-output classifier path and require redacted Telegram Desktop, gateway-log, terminal/live-output, or linked-artifact proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans heartbeat isolation, Telegram-visible delivery proof, and adjacent heartbeat test ownership.
